title: BlockLock: Reproducible LLM Inference with Fixed Batch Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2611.06977v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reproducible LLM inference requires that a request produces the same output regardless of the other requests in the batch. Existing solutions pay for this in different ways: batch-invariant kernels constrain every operator, and isolating prefill with fixed-shape decode ({our CoRun-style baseline}) gives up shared prefill compute and pads decode. We present BlockLock, which keeps shared batched prefill and pins only the numerical path of the protected request: it fixes the geometry that the request sees, with {two modes: BlockLock-Rows uses fixed-width rows and retains batched decode of all requests; BlockLock-Pack uses terminal-anchored packing with an isolated dummy segment, then extracts the protected request's KV state for target-only decode. translated_title: BlockLock：通过固定批次几何形状实现可复现的LLM推理
translated_abstract: 可复现的LLM推理要求无论批次中的其他请求如何，某个请求都能产生相同的输出。现有解决方案以不同方式为此付出代价：批次不变内核需要约束每一个算子，而通过固定形状解码隔离预填充（我们的CoRun风格基线）则放弃了共享的预填充计算并对解码进行填充。我们提出了BlockLock，它保留共享的批次预填充，仅固定受保护请求的数值路径：它固定请求所看到的几何形状，并提供两种模式：BlockLock-Rows使用固定宽度的行并保留所有请求的批次解码；BlockLock-Pack使用终端锚定打包并配以隔离的虚拟段，然后提取受保护请求的KV状态用于仅针对目标的解码。在规定的逐部署契约下，当伴随请求发生变化时，两种模式都能按位保留目标的输出。在五个稠密模型（Qwen3-8B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct以及Gemma-3-4B等）上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: BlockLock通过仅固定受保护请求所见的批次几何形状（而非约束所有算子或放弃共享计算），在保留共享批次预填充的前提下实现了逐位可复现的LLM推理。
en_tdlr: BlockLock achieves bitwise-reproducible LLM inference by pinning only the protected request's batch geometry—while retaining shared batched prefill—instead of constraining every operator or sacrificing shared prefill compute.
